test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and courses of action carefully and decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

If none of the employees submit their work report by tomorrow, then the monthly project will be in a crisis.

**Courses of action:**

i. The date of submission of work report must be extended.

ii. Some employees must speed up and submit their work report by tomorrow.

iii. The cause of late submission of work report by most employees must be figured out and proper counter; measures must be taken.
solution:
**Explanation:**

From the given statement:

If none of the employees submit their work report by tomorrow, then the monthly project will be in a crisis.

We consider the given courses of action:

**i. The date of submission of work report must be extended: **The statement suggests that being late will result in crisis and there is no indication towards the date being extended so it will be wrong to assume. Thus this course of action does not follow. <br
